t: What he announced from the pulpit, and who understood it
a: إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَيَّرَ عَبْدًا بَيْنَ الدُّنْيَا وَبَيْنَ مَا عِنْدَهُ، فَاخْتَارَ مَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ
p: Inna-Llāha khayyara ʿabdan bayna-d-dunyā wa bayna mā ʿindah, fa-khtāra mā ʿinda-Llāh
m: Allah gave a servant the choice between this world and what is with Him, and he chose what is with Allah.
